extraFacts.fact: ORS is Eaton Aeroquip's name for the O-ring face seal connection (ORFS, SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3): a flat-faced fitting whose face carries an O-ring that seals against the flat face of a female swivel nut; the thread holds the joint and the O-ring seals.
extraFacts.source: SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3; Eaton Aeroquip catalogue (ORS)

extraFacts.fact: SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 is the O-ring boss port: a straight UN/UNF thread with an O-ring under the hex shoulder that makes the seal.
ASME B1.20.3 (Dryseal NPTF) is the pipe thread standard for NPTF threads, which seal on the taper with sealant.
